design_intent: 保留已授权角色 IP 的成熟辨识度与核心动作，把过于端正的编辑卡通表面转换成毛毡手作、贴纸轮廓和丑萌怪趣的视觉版本。

surface.primary_medium: layered handmade wool felt with visible fibers, soft stuffed volume and irregular blanket stitching
surface.secondary_medium: die-cut sticker-like outer silhouettes and small paper-label accents, used as contour language rather than a collage of unrelated stickers
surface.shape_language: slightly wonky, chunky and asymmetrical shapes with deliberately imperfect hand-cut edges
surface.face_language: mature recognizable face simplified into an ugly-cute felt puppet expression; allow one raised eyebrow, a crooked smile or deadpan surprise, but never a baby face
surface.object_language: 把抽象概念变成一本正经地荒谬的熟悉物件；道具可夸张、漏气、打结、歪斜或互相较劲，但因果关系必须准确
surface.depth: shallow tactile relief, soft contact shadows and layered felt thickness; visibly handmade, never glossy 3D product rendering
surface.background: clean warm off-white craft-paper field with very sparse confetti-like felt scraps outside all text and subtitle safe zones

humor_contract.gag_budget: 每张只设一个一眼能懂的主笑点，笑点服务认知锚点
humor_contract.tone: 古怪、机灵、松弛、一本正经地胡闹

palette.rule: 每张最多两个高饱和强调色；橙色仍承担主动作路径

cohesion: 人物、道具、动作线与装饰必须像同一套手工材料一次完成；不得出现真人抠图、光滑商业 3D 或两套不一致的光影。
